newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: ITG places 1.4 mln shares on new Irish DCM.
newsitem.headline: ITG places 1.4 mln shares on new Irish DCM.

text.p: The newly-formed Developing Companies Market (DCM) on the Irish stock exchange has attracted its first public flotation, the Irish Independent newspaper reported on Monday.

Independent Telecoms Group (ITG), a telecommunications sales and servicing company, has announced it will place 1.4 million ordinary shares on the DCM and on its equivalent market in London, the Alternative Investment Market (AIM).
The shares are being placed at 156 Irish pence in Dublin and 148 pence stg in London.
The share placing, which will raise 1.7 million for the company, net of expenses, is fully underwritten by the sponsoring stockbrokers Goodbody in Dublin and Townsley & Co in London.
